requirement: Every time an order-sourced loyalty transaction is created, award points at 1 point per dollar. The dollar amount is on the order.
hidden_intent: When the Pronto app posts an order, create an Earn Loyalty Transaction with points = floor(order total). They assume order data exists in Salesforce; it would come from the app payload.

expect.notes: Loyalty_Transaction__c has no amount field and Transaction__c has no custom fields; 'the order' has no home in the org — must ask where order totals come from.
